chapter: Reel 4: boyhood bands and the drummers he admired
title: Ten years as house drummer at the Central Plaza alongside Zutty Singleton
summary: He was house drummer at the Central Plaza with Conrad Janis's group while Zutty Singleton led the other half-hour set.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Uh huh. Did you ever run into Zutty Singleton or Big Sid or any of those guys?
I had the pleasure of working with Zutty Singleton at the Central Plaza on Second Avenue and 6th Street for 10 years; I was like the house drummer up
there, and Zutty Singleton was the other house drummer, because they used to have two bands up there and each of them played a half hour set, and I was with Conrad Janis, who had the group up there.
Yeah, he played with them -- a trombone player.
Yeah, he played for him quite a bit. He was an actor or something, wasn't he?
